steps.label: 3012-own-paper1094-select-set242
command: (()=>{if(new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('paperId')!=='1094')throw Error('Own paper only');const m=document.querySelector('#paperItemAddModal'),c=m.querySelector('[data-candidate-check][value="2089242"]');if(!m.classList.contains('show')||!c||c.disabled||c.checked||c.dataset.passageId!=='2089241'||m.querySelectorAll('[data-candidate-check]').length!==1)throw Error('Expected sole approved set candidate');c.click();return {selected:[...m.querySelectorAll('[data-candidate-check]:checked')].map(e=>e.value),addDisabled:m.querySelector('[data-paper-item-add]').disabled};})()
